metadata.title: Ethereal Red Double Exposure Album Art

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, moody composition featuring a central silhouette of a person with their head tilted back, layered with a double exposure of a dense cloud bed. The entire scene is bathed in a deep, saturated red-to-black gradient with heavy film grain and analog dust artifacts.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject silhouette integrated with cloud textures
Vertical light leak contrasting with deep shadows
Textural grit overlaying smooth color gradients
Central figure balanced by a secondary partial silhouette on the right
coreInvariants: Heavy analog film grain and dust
Double exposure effect between human form and clouds
High contrast between the bright red sky and black silhouettes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is centered, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, with the head positioned in the upper center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The head of the central figure, which acts as the focal point for the double exposure effect.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright red glow at the top left, down the central silhouette, and finally to the metadata text in the bottom right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the frame is dominated by a red atmospheric glow, providing breathing room for the dense textures below.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Crimson and Scarlet (Atmosphere and Midtones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds with extreme value contrast between the light source and the subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in varying weights or sizes for metadata blocks.
graphicDevices: Light leak on the left edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, industrial look of standard advisory labels.
Provides the necessary verticality and tight spacing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a double exposure image of a man's silhouette looking up, blended with a texture of thick clouds. Apply a heavy red and black color grade with a vertical orange-red light leak on the left. Add significant film grain, white dust specks, and hair-like scratches across the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small block of white sans-serif text in the bottom right corner, stacked in three lines, using a bold condensed font.

verificationChecks: Is the red color saturated and dominant?
Is the double exposure effect visible in the head area?
Is the film grain and dust texture prominent?
Is the text positioned in the bottom right corner?

adjustableVariables: Density of the cloud texture in the double exposure
Amount of film grain and dust
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any existing logos or brand-specific text
postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless blending between the silhouette and clouds
Ensure the grain does not obscure the text legibility
Verify the light leak feels integrated rather than pasted on
Confirm the red palette remains moody rather than bright
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a human silhouette with a natural texture (clouds/water) using double exposure, apply a monochromatic high-contrast color grade, and finish with heavy analog film artifacts and a corner-aligned metadata block.
